repository.role: Ecosystem neural-architecture coordinator and Duck OS integration authority
repository.domain: Duck OS user-space services, process isolation, event orchestration, system capability contracts and cross-repository integration
repository.implementation_track: Reaper-native system integration for Duck OS; versioned JSON contracts; isolated user-space execution only

responsibilities: Own the canonical twenty-profile catalogue and shared neural-contract vocabulary for the Ivan-VHS ecosystem.
Define Duck OS service boundaries, process isolation, permission checks and explicit resource budgets for any future model runtime.
Coordinate versioned adapters between Reaper, Pytyliki, OPlague and VentuSample without introducing a mandatory central inference dependency.
Keep future inference in isolated user space; neural execution must never be placed inside the Duck kernel.
non_goals: No neural execution, training, model download or network telemetry is enabled by this contract.
No kernel, driver, firmware or system configuration is modified by a model result.
Duck OS native system code is not moved to Python, and no hidden external runtime is introduced.

proposed_interfaces.summary: Canonical ecosystem profile catalogue and contract vocabulary.
Proposed isolated user-space service envelope with explicit permissions and budgets.
Proposed versioned result envelope for peer adapters.
Future typed request and result representation owned by Reaper.
Future deterministic contract and numerical validation adapter.
Future read-only device and GPU evidence snapshot.
Future offline audio feature and generation metadata.

semantic_guarantees: Unknown, missing or unavailable measurements remain explicit and are never silently coerced to zero.
Every request carries a stable request identifier, source provenance and a content digest.
Every future model result records its profile, model version, input digest, uncertainty and evidence references.
Determinism is claimed only for execution paths covered by reproducible tests and explicit seed/version controls.
Model output is advisory; side effects require a separately validated adapter and explicit policy or human approval.
Raw datasets, secrets and personal data are excluded from diagnostic logs.

quality_gates: Validate the local catalogue and repository contract against the versioned JSON Schema.
Record dataset provenance, licence, consent, purpose limitation, retention and deletion rules before training.
Separate training, validation and test data by source and prevent leakage across correlated samples.
Measure a documented non-neural baseline before claiming model benefit.
Test accuracy, calibration, uncertainty, out-of-domain inputs and failure behavior on representative fixtures.
Record model identity, training recipe, data snapshot digest, seeds and build/runtime versions for reproducibility.
Enforce explicit memory, CPU/GPU, queue, timeout and latency budgets before enabling execution.
Threat-model untrusted inputs, imported model artifacts, deserialization and model-output side effects.
Require human review, a feature branch, CI evidence and a rollback plan for model or contract changes.
Keep local/offline execution as the default and verify that no data leaves the repository or host without explicit approval.
